text:
ryan: hey everyone — first morning at Redwood! laptop and monitor arrived but a couple issues: 

ryan: 1) the shipping box for the monitor was pretty smashed and the monitor stand is missing (only panel + power brick). opened TKT-21345.
ryan: 2) i can join Corp-WiFi but when i try to access any internal site i get a 403/blocked page that says 'Device not compliant' — i think conditional access is blocking me.

sarah-onboarding: welcome ryan!! :tada: tagging IT and ops. sorry about the monitor, we'll sort it. for CA issues, @anna-it will help.

anna-it: hey ryan, welcome. conditional access usually needs device registration (Azure AD) + company endpoint config. can you check Settings > Accounts > Access work or school and see if your device shows 'Connected to <tenant>'? also run in cmd as admin: ```dsregcmd /status``` and paste the Device State lines.

ryan: Settings shows "Not connected to organization". ran dsregcmd /status snippet: "DeviceState : NotJoined
AzureAdJoined : NO
DomainJoined : NO"

anna-it: yep not joined. did you follow the Windows auto-enroll link in your welcome email (the Company Portal app)? sometimes the Company Portal is required before the MDM pushes compliance policy. do you have Company Portal installed?

ryan: i don't see Company Portal installed. i have admin permissions disabled (corporate standard) so i can't install from webstore.

anna-it: ok i'll push Company Portal via Intune and trigger an enrollment invite. give me ~10 minutes, you should see a toast to install or a web prompt to sign in. once installed sign in with your work account and then check dsregcmd again.

mike-ops: @ryan on the monitor: inventory-bot flagged that the box was RMA'd on shipping. mike-ops here — we can either ship a replacement stand today (overnight) or leave one in the supplies locker on 4 (code 9922). what do you prefer?

ryan: locker pickup would be fastest for me, thanks. i'll grab it after standup. can you put it in locker 4 please?

inventory-bot: [automated] Replacement stand reserved for ryan in locker 4 (code 9922). Please return unused accessories to ops within 14 days.

anna-it: pushed Company Portal and Intune enrollment. you should get a notification to sign in. after sign-in, reboot and run dsregcmd /status again. also check Company Portal > Devices to accept any MDM prompts.

ryan: got the Company Portal prompt, signed in, accepted device management. rebooting now.

ryan: dsregcmd /status now shows "AzureAdJoined : YES
DeviceState : AzureAdJoined" and i can reach internal sites. access appears unblocked.

mike-ops: stand in locker 4 confirmed picked up by ryan at 10:15. thanks for the quick pickup.

ryan: monitor stand attached, display fine. everything works now — wifi/site access fixed and stand retrieved. thanks team! closing TKT-21345 from my side. :white_check_mark:
